entries.source_section_or_line: the zero-fee slow-maker row and its reading in SYSTEM_STATE 527
entries.old_statement: the zero-fee slow-maker gain was reported as -0.262 / -0.273 / +0.373 and read as 'only SOL is positive before fees'
entries.corrected_statement: R at phi=0 is NOT a plateau, so calling the 600 s value R_inf is a CHOICE and the zero-fee SIGN inherits it. H-U6's own table: R rises to 600 s then falls to 0.0182 / -0.1494 / -0.4682 at 3600 s, giving zero-fee gains of -0.0104 / +0.1760 / +1.1277. ETH is NEGATIVE at 60 s and 600 s and POSITIVE at 3600 s, so 'only SOL is positive before fees' is horizon-conditional and should have been stated as a range. AT THE CANONICAL 2.0 bps MAKER FEE EVERY HORIZON ON EVERY SYMBOL STAYS NEGATIVE, so the economic verdict is unaffected -- what is corrected is a zero-fee descriptive claim, not the conclusion.
